title: 22.9. Kusalattika, Kāmāvacaraduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakusalaṁ nakāmāvacaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā pañca, adhipatiyā pañca …pe… aññamaññe tīṇi …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate pañca.
Nakusalaṁ nanakāmāvacaraṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca abyākato nakāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
